_doc: Per-function emit progress and file routing -- the source of truth for what has been emitted and what is left. Version controlled, because a run that is interrupted has to be able to resume from disk with no conversation context. `status` advances pending -> emitted -> reviewed -> committed; `failed` and `skip` are terminal and both must appear in the closing report. `body_size` is the Ghidra body size the emit was made against: on resume it is compared with ghidra_snapshot/functions.txt, and an entry whose function has since changed size is retired and re-emitted rather than being skipped as done. There is deliberately no commit hash here -- one cannot be recorded inside the commit that creates it; the landing commit carries the address in its subject, so `git log --oneline --grep "@ <addr>"` finds it. `target` is the .c file the function belongs in; ticket 21.5 owns the full routing table and will populate the rest.
